preconditions.description: The number of names, n, is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(name_i) <= 100 for name_i in names)
preconditions.description: Each name has length between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(name_i.islower() and name_i.isalpha() for name_i in names)
preconditions.description: Each name consists only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Impossible' or (len(stdout) == 26 and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in stdout) and len(set(stdout)) == 26)
postconditions.description: If no valid order exists, output 'Impossible'. Otherwise, output a permutation of all 26 lowercase letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout != 'Impossible' and all(names[i] < names[i+1] for i in range(n-1))
postconditions.description: If a valid order exists, the names must be sorted lexicographically under the custom alphabet defined by the output permutation.

postconditions.expression: stdout != 'Impossible' and all(names[i] < names[i+1] for i in range(n-1))
postconditions.description: The custom alphabet (output permutation) must satisfy the lexicographical order of all consecutive name pairs in the input.
